retry_reasons: metrics lines does not rescan the store under the write lock, so a ticket changed meanwhile by another process can be overwritten
Skipped tickets keep taking the limit window of metrics lines on every call, and the help does not say how to get past them
The help of the pr option of ticket update does not say that removing or changing the PR removes lines
ADR-029 states the per-call limit of metrics lines, which is an operational detail and not a decision
